data_fields.name: reward_value
data_fields.donor_constant: mandatory integer 'value' on the mission record; copied to the mission at create

data_fields.name: deadline_ticks
data_fields.donor_constant: record deadline (duration or variable); 0 = no deadline; evaluated at accept

data_fields.name: game_turn_step
data_fields.donor_constant: one turn per do_turn call; mission tick runs once per turn

best_idea: A quest is a data record with one goal kind, a status (yet_to_start, in_progress, success, failure), a deadline, and a completion predicate per goal kind; a quest given by an NPC is paid only when the player reports back to that NPC.
decision_why: Keep the state machine, the per-goal predicate table, the report-back gate and the reward as one ledger credit; reject the NPC-owes debt ceiling and the client-side inventory polling, which the one-ledger and server-verified rulings forbid.
acceptance: Server test: a giver quest whose objective is met stays pending and pays 0 until the player reports to the giver; the report credits the one ledger once with the quest value; a second report credits nothing; a quest past its deadline ends failure with no credit.
